title: the pygmalion effect in ai: influence of cultural narratives and policies on technological development
core_idea: To investigate how AI research, cinematographic representations, and regulatory policies interact to shape technological development and public perception, and to examine the roles of cultural narratives (pygmalion effect) and regulatory responses (golem effect) in influencing social expectations and AI trajectories.
tldr: A comprehensive study designed to analyze the interplay between AI research, film portrayals, and policy frameworks to understand how cultural narratives and regulations may shape AI development and public perception.
